newsitem.title: USA: Mo. legislature passes $380.2 mln capital budget.
newsitem.headline: Mo. legislature passes $380.2 mln capital budget.

text.p: Missouri legislators approved a $380.2 million capital budget for the fiscal biennium beginning July 1, state budget director Mark Ward said Monday.
Legislators approved the spending package for the 1998-99 biennium on Friday, including spending for construction of new prisons and state veterans facilities, Brown said.
Missouri Gov. Mel Carnahan is pleased with the capital budget, will review it and will probably sign the spending package, spokesman Chris Sifford said.
The package includes $246.3 million from general revenues, $38.7 million from federal sources and $95.2 million from other state funds, Ward said.

Missouri will issue debt in financing two of the projects through lease-purchase arrangements, Ward said. About $12.75 million of a $38 million mental health facility and part of a $25 million 768-bed prison expansion will use lease-purchase arrangements, he said.

Legislators approved spending $146 million for two new 1,500-bed maximum security prisons on sites to be determined, Ward said. They also approved a $6 million 256-bed expansion at another prison, he said.

Another $22 million has been appropriated for construction of a new veterans facility in southwest Missouri at a site to be determined and $17 million for a new veterans facility in Warrensburg, Ward said.
